post.description: nomorPo is generated (PO-001, PO-002, ...). The approval request must be a purchase-request in status approved, 409 otherwise. One request may have several POs. subtotal, dppLain, nilaiPpn and grandTotal are computed by the server and rounded to a rupiah: subtotal = sum of (jumlah * hargaSatuan - diskon), dppLain (DPP nilai lain) = subtotal * 11 / 12, nilaiPpn = dppLain * persenPpn / 100, grandTotal = subtotal + nilaiPpn + jasa. diskon is rupiah per line. Sending dppLain is a 400.

Changing only the letter case of its own name is allowed. 404 when the id does not exist, 409 when another row has the name.

post.summary: Import many items in one transaction
post.description: Names, not ids: category, unit and locationCode are resolved case-insensitively, and a row falls back to defaults for category and unit. supplier is optional per row (no defaults.supplier): a name is matched case-insensitively to suppliers.name, a name that matches no supplier or more than one is a row error under items.<row>.supplier, and left out means supplierId null until Purchasing sets one with PUT /api/v1/items/{id}. It is the first mapping only. Nothing is auto-created. An unknown or ambiguous name, a missing value, or a missing permission fails the whole request. Needs item.create, plus item.set-price when any price is not 0, item.adjust-stock when any stock is above 0, item.assign-location when any row has code or locationCode, and item.set-supplier when any row has supplier (otherwise 403). Superadmin passes all of them. A row already in the database (same code, or same name when the row has no code and the stored item has no code) or repeated earlier in the file is skipped and listed in skipped, so the same file can be imported again. Initial stock is recorded as an audit entry with reason 'Initial import'. With dryRun true nothing is written and items[].id is null. Validation failure is 400 with errors keyed like items.4.category, where the row number starts at 1.

Stock moves by the net difference per item in one transaction, 400 if any item would drop below 0. 409 once more than 24 hours have passed since the transaction was recorded.
